products.name: Sugaree - Clementine - 1G Cart - Melted Diamonds
products.description: Sugaree's Clementine 1G Cartridge delivers an uplifting sativa experience perfect for daytime enjoyment. This premium distillate cartridge captures the bright, citrusy essence of Clementine with every draw, offering energizing effects that spark creativity and focus. The sweet, tangy clementine flavor profile shines through, complemented by subtle herbal notes that make each puff refreshing and smooth. Ideal for those seeking a clear-headed, euphoric high, this sativa cart helps elevate your mood while keeping you alert and productive. The convenient 1-gram cartridge fits standard 510 thread batteries, making it easy to enjoy on the go. Whether you're tackling creative projects, socializing with friends, or simply need a burst of positivity, Sugaree's Clementine cartridge brings vibrant citrus flavor and focused energy to your cannabis routine. Experience the zesty, uplifting power of this sativa-dominant distillate.

products.name: Sugaree - Strawana - 1G Cart - Melted Diamonds
products.description: Sugaree's Strawana 1G Cartridge delivers a premium melted diamonds experience in a convenient 510 thread format. This hybrid vape cart combines potent THC diamonds with rich terpenes for exceptional flavor and balanced effects. The Strawana strain profile features luscious strawberry and tropical banana notes that create a sweet, fruity aroma with every pull. Expect uplifting cerebral energy paired with gentle body relaxation—perfect for creative sessions or social gatherings. The melted diamonds extraction process preserves maximum cannabinoids and terpenes, ensuring smooth hits and full-spectrum effects. Compatible with any standard 510 battery, this 1 gram cartridge offers portability without sacrificing quality. Whether you're seeking focus, euphoria, or simply a delicious vaping experience, Sugaree's Strawana cart brings craft cannabis concentrates to your fingertips.

products.name: Sugaree - Gelato - 1G Cart - Melted Diamonds
products.description: Sugaree's Gelato 1g cartridge delivers a premium indica experience in a convenient distillate format. This smooth-hitting cart captures Gelato's signature dessert-like profile with sweet, creamy notes complemented by hints of citrus and berry. As an indica-dominant option, it promotes deep relaxation and tranquility, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or easing into restful sleep. The distillate formulation ensures consistent potency and clean vapor with every draw, while the 510 thread compatibility fits most standard batteries for on-the-go convenience. Gelato's balanced effects may also spark euphoria and happiness alongside its calming properties. Perfect for evening use or anytime you need to melt away stress and tension. Sugaree brings quality craftsmanship to this beloved strain, offering a flavorful and reliable cartridge experience.
